scope: Four independently reviewed original paper statements; proofs sorry; six blocked targets excluded

correction.printed: For S subset [m], Lemma 12 gives |S| * poly(log n, r_K, B_K, epsilon inverse) quantum gates and D.1/D.2 queries; D.2 writes A_j^sign / Tr(A_j^sign) without a zero-trace convention.
correction.changed: Require S nonempty and include an elementary address-cost factor 1 + log m in both the |S| bound and its Phi corollary. Permit arbitrary normalized D.2 outputs for zero PSD components and arbitrary unitary completions on unused qubit labels, preserving the promises on every nonzero component.
correction.why: The all-zero initialized elementary-gate model must prepare an m-valued address: for singleton S at a distant index this requires Omega(log m) one- or two-qubit gates, while the printed bound has no m dependence. Empty S makes the printed bound zero although K=0 has Gibbs state I/n, which is mixed for n>1. The paper explicitly applies Lemma 12 with zero components on p.29, and Lemma 11 assigns them zero selection probability; excluding them drops source cases. No nonzero quotient, Gibbs target, rank/trace bound, oracle count, accuracy, or quantifier order is changed.
